messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: linear programming bound with explicit certificate

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration in the unit square achieving the maximum minimum triangle area is exactly the affine image of the regular hexagonal lattice, arranged as three rows of points at heights y = 1/4, 1/2, 3/4 with horizontal offsets 1/6, 1/3, 1/6 respectively, yielding a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/48. A linear programming certificate proving optimality exists using the method of difference triangles on the 4×6 integer grid, where the LP objective value equals 1/48, matching the construction."}
